branch_card_rules.single_cell: geometry + spring class + compression program + fixture freedom
branch_card_rules.one_bit: pair topology + 45 mm preload + observed start + selected manipulation/sweep + torque-off verification
branch_card_rules.two_bit: four-slot topology + separate 50/47.5 mm preloads + channels + preparation/coupled epoch programs + safe reset
branch_card_rules.paper_compare: paper net/material/joins + qualitative matching policy + safe manipulation

unknown_value_policy: null is missing, not zero, not a default and not authorization to improvise
task_input_vs_source: Every supplied non-source value must be marked task_authored_qualified_input and cannot be reported as historical fact
preassembled_handoff_policy: Allowed only as explicitly selected scope variation; record supplier/ID/version and outside-scope fabrication. Whole-paper fabrication goal cannot be completed this way.
